connectionTypes.sourceNote: SOURCED (secondary) — BESCOM LT-3 Commercial, flat rate, per multiple bill-calculator sites citing the March 2025 KERC combined tariff order (eff. April 2025): Rs.8.00/unit + Rs.210/kW fixed charge. This file's top-level Rs.0.36/unit KERC surcharge and electricity duty (not modelled at top level either) apply on top. One secondary source instead cited Rs.5.95/unit + 9% duty for this category, but that figure looked like a probable mix-up with the residential LT-2A rate on the same page, so it was not used. Pending primary KERC order cross-check.

SOURCED (secondary) — BESCOM LT-5 Industrial per bill-calculator sites citing the March 2025 KERC order: Rs.180/kW fixed charge (consistent across sources); energy rate Rs.6.50/unit up to 500 units and Rs.7.50/unit above 500. Pending primary KERC order cross-check.

SOURCED (secondary) — BESCOM LT-4 IP-set (irrigation pump set) agricultural category: pump sets up to 10HP receive free electricity under Karnataka's long-standing farm-power subsidy (well-documented policy, also referenced in KERC tariff commentary re LT-4(a)). Above 10HP or unmetered/other sub-categories may attract charges cited inconsistently across sources (Rs.3.50-8.30/unit) — not modelled here given the conflicting figures. Pending primary KERC order cross-check.

subsidySchemes.eligibility: domestic Gruha Jyothi (within household baseline average)

verifiedBy: SOURCED (secondary) — BESCOM LT-2a urban domestic slabs, ₹110/kW fixed and ₹0.36/unit KERC surcharge (Apr 2025). Gruha Jyothi free-200 is conditional on each household's prior-year average; this file models the simple free-200 case. Electricity tax not modelled. Pending primary KERC order cross-check.
